doubts.claim: The three portable tests genuinely close the Linux diff-coverage gap without masking platform defects.
doubts.counterexample: Tests could merely mock return values, bypass real file/capture behavior, or pretend POSIX paths behave like Windows paths without exercising the transformation branches.
doubts.evidence_needed: Direct execution of every missed line, real bounded-tail file I/O, real capture state, isolated platform simulation limited to deterministic path-string branches, and green focused/full suites.
doubts.disposition: The tests directly execute suite_process lines 65-66 and 76 using a real bounded capture and real seek/read file, and execute every suite_diagnostics Windows path branch at lines 42-47. Only os.name and Path.resolve are isolated for the deterministic Windows prefix transformation; existing native Windows tests remain intact. The change is test-only, focused tests pass 16/16, the full tools root passes 470 with 15 skipped and 2 deselected, and post-CI code review is empty.
